In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the simulations presented in this paper are able to reproduce a number of important properties of real clusters, but that the agreement is not perfect and some important discrepancies remain.
the simulations presented here do not yet reproduce all observed properties of the galaxy population in galaxy clusters, but they are able to explain a large number of them.

the galaxy formation in the cluster environments is a very complicated process, and the simulations are still far from being able to reproduce all the observed properties of the galaxy population, although the results are quite encouraging.
